purpose: Reproducible qualification matrix for the R4SNES subsystem

policies.implementation: Fresh Zig implementation; comparison implementations are behavioral oracles, never sole truth
reference_priority: self-checking open tests and real-hardware results
independent open test programs and synthetic owner models
agreement between at least two independent emulator implementations
manual observation only in the final roadmap subversion
policies.visual_cases: A visual ROM becomes a gate only after a licensed real-hardware baseline, exact pixel invariant, register protocol, or other machine-readable expectation is bound
policies.private_target: SMW.SFC is excluded from public automation and used only in 0.73.23
policies.firmware: No proprietary IPL, NEC DSP, ST010/ST011, or ST018 firmware image is distributed. The CX4 mathematical ROM, six open uPD7725 qualification images, two in-memory uPD96050 owner profiles and one exact-size ARMv3/ST018 image are generated reproducibly; product NEC/ST firmware still requires an exact user-owned revision image
policies.dma_cases: Tests/dma_reference_cases.json binds four synthetic model oracles and three digest-pinned current/historical Undisbeliever diagnostics; none is a gate without a machine-readable hardware oracle
policies.ppu_cases: Tests/ppu_reference_cases.json binds twelve exact mode-0-through-7/effect XRGB32 owner digests, all 15 VMAIN cartridges and selected effect/example/hardware/HDRV diagnostics; visual cartridges remain non-gating without a licensed hardware pixel or register oracle
policies.hdrv_geometry_cases: Tests/hdrv_geometry_cases.json executes nine BGMODE/SETINI scripts against the production PPU and requires native 256/512 by 224/239/448/478 publication; subjective cartridge checks remain deferred to 0.73.23
policies.smp_cases: The production SPC700 executes every one of 256000 register, PSW, PC/SP, changed-ARAM and explicit read/write/wait traces; Gilyon spctest and the 32768-byte IPL speed protocol execute through the real S-CPU/APU latches; timer, low-power, oscillator-partition and private-firmware cases are owner gates
policies.sdsp_cases: Tests/sdsp_reference_cases.json binds nine synthetic stereo PCM, register and echo-RAM digests to an exact independent SNES-SPC revision; owner tests execute every case through the production S-DSP, while the WAV analyzer rejects wrong rate, frequency, continuity, polarity or channel ratio
policies.enhancement_chip_cases: Tests/enhancement_test.zig drives OBC-1, S-RTC, S-DD1 and SPC7110 through the production cartridge and bus. S-DD1 covers all bitplane/context modes, DMA shadow activation, byte-exact streamed output, bank windows and SRAM; SPC7110 covers all decompression modes, PROM/DROM mapping, data-port seek/stride, arithmetic, SRAM gating and Epson protocol/calendar behavior. Tests/enhancement_reference_cases.json binds seven original synthetic streams to byte-identical Mesen2 and Snes9x traces and a third Ares source review. Tests/superfx_test.zig drives GSU-1/GSU-2 through all 256 opcodes under all four ALT states, exact cache/bus/IRQ/clock behavior, all pixel depths and height layouts, arbitrary slices and SRAM persistence. WLA-DX 10.7 reproducibly builds two unchanged OpenSNES and four original owner programs; their exact RAM/state/frame aggregate is bound and the 3D example is checked against an independent 16384-pixel Bresenham oracle. Tests/sa1_test.zig covers the private 65C816, mapping/protection/contention, DMA/conversion, arithmetic, VBR, timers and arbitrary slices; six pinned hardware ROMs run through the production dual-CPU/PPU harness with deterministic-field masks and two-start BW-RAM persistence. Tests/cx4_test.zig and the reproducible WLA-DX harness cover the complete HG51B encoding, cache, DMA, bus, IRQ, reset, fixed-point mathematical ROM and original geometry/pixel programs against exact Ares and Mesen2 source pins. Tests/nec_dsp_test.zig and the generated firmware harness cover the complete shared uPD7725/uPD77C25/uPD96050 instruction/ALU/branch/host matrix, all six DSP and both ST board revisions, appended and separate firmware, exact known digests, 14-bit banked control flow, 11-bit pointers, Setz RAM/register mirrors, slicing, reset and isolation against exact Ares and Mesen2 source pins; an optional private run boots all eight known revision paths and executes a DSP-1B Q15 multiply without emitting firmware. Tests/st018_test.zig plus its generated firmware harness cover ARMv3 modes, decoder, pipeline, ALU/shifter/multiply, transfers, exceptions, exact ST018 memories/bridge/reset/timer, slicing, isolation and exact private-firmware validation against pinned Ares and Mesen2 sources. persistence_test.zig covers exact OBC-1/S-RTC/Epson/Super-FX/SA-1/ST010/ST018 restart and checksum-valid semantic corruption

dma_reference_cases.diagnostic_policy: Bounded timeout and first-bus-divergence records are mandatory; visual or revision-uncertain results never become pass/fail truth

ppu_reference_cases.diagnostic_policy: Every owner model has an exact XRGB32 FNV-1a digest; foreign visual and beam-sensitive ROMs require a licensed revision-bound oracle before promotion

smp_reference_cases.single_step_expectation: Exact A/X/Y/SP/PC/PSW, listed ARAM and every read/write/wait cycle
smp_reference_cases.gilyon_spctest_expectation: Success through the production W65C816 bus, four ordered latches, semantic IPL upload and production SPC700
owner_cases: semantic, exact, missing and invalid IPL paths

sdsp_reference_cases.oracle_license: LGPL-2.1; comparison executed only from the workspace-local reference tree; no oracle code is copied into R4SNES
sdsp_reference_cases.expectation: Exact native stereo S16LE FNV-1a digest plus ENDX, ENVX0, OUTX0 and echo-RAM digest for every case
coverage: echo RAM, feedback and all eight FIR taps
sdsp_reference_cases.resampler: Partition-invariant rational 32000-to-48000-Hz stereo S16LE; caller blocks at most 2048 frames; fixed 8192-frame queue
sdsp_reference_cases.runtime: Prefill, underflow, overflow, mute, backend degradation, reset and idempotent close are owner-tested through r4os.subsystem_runtime without guest-time coupling
sdsp_reference_cases.wav_analyzer: Tests/Analyze-SdspWav.ps1 self-tests accepted 440-Hz stereo and rejects a missing 10-ms quantum, wrong frequency and wrong channel ratio

enhancement_reference_cases.expectation: Four S-DD1 bitplane/context streams and three SPC7110 1/2/4-bpp streams match every byte; product output remains identical across arbitrary host slices
enhancement_reference_cases.data_policy: Original generated bytes only; no commercial ROM or title-derived data

superfx_reference_cases.assembler: WLA-DX 10.7 wla-superfx/wlalink, pinned Linux and Windows binaries
superfx_reference_cases.pixel_oracle: OpenSNES superfx_3d output must match an independently generated 128x128 four-plane Bresenham bitmap at all 16384 pixels
superfx_reference_cases.persistence: Battery-backed 32/64/128-KiB GSU work RAM uses the canonical normalized-ROM HASH.SAV; battery-less GSU boards never access persistence
superfx_reference_cases.data_policy: OpenSNES source plus original synthetic R4SNES programs only; no commercial ROM, title table or proprietary firmware

sa1_reference_cases.self_test_completion: WRAM 0x000000 must become 0x01 within 20000000 S-CPU instructions and 12 NTSC seconds; 0xFE and 0xFF are distinct diagnostics
sa1_reference_cases.defined_field_policy: Tilemap/WRAM/device digests are exact where portable; documented open-bus, reset and undefined register fields remain diagnostic and are excluded explicitly
sa1_reference_cases.artifacts: Each phase writes a 2048-byte tilemap and 256x224 PPM under Temp/R4SNES-SA1
sa1_reference_cases.persistence: SA1BackupUtility runs cold and warm with only its exact 128-KiB BW-RAM carried over; I-RAM and processor/register state restart. Battery-less SA-1 boards never access persistence
sa1_reference_cases.data_policy: Open licensed test ROMs only; the private SMW cartridge is excluded

cx4_reference_cases.assembler: WLA-DX 10.7 wla-cx4/wlalink rebuilt from pinned source on Linux or using the pinned official Windows tools
cx4_reference_cases.exact_outputs: All 16 GPRs in the public HG51B instruction program plus owner vector, matrix, signed multiply, trigonometry, transfer, wireframe, sprite-pixel, DMA and asynchronous bus oracles
cx4_reference_cases.data_policy: No commercial ROM bytes, proprietary firmware payload, title table or title-specific command HLE; the mathematical ROM is generated from integer formulae

nec_dsp_reference_cases.private_gate: Optional only: exact known revision hashes, six successful firmware boots and public DSP-1B command 0x00 Q15 multiply 0x4000 * 0x4000 = 0x2000; no private byte or derived command table is emitted
nec_dsp_reference_cases.identity_policy: SHA-256 cartridge identity covers only normalized game ROM after copier-header and appended-firmware removal; separate firmware produces the same identity
nec_dsp_reference_cases.data_policy: Six original generated open firmware fixtures are public. Proprietary DSP firmware, commercial ROM bytes, title tables, automatic downloads and command HLE are forbidden

st01x_reference_cases.core: NEC uPD96050 shared with the uPD7725/uPD77C25 decoder
st01x_reference_cases.owner_gate: Tests/nec_dsp_test.zig plus optional private execution in Tests/nec_dsp_firmware_harness.zig
st01x_reference_cases.persistence: Exact battery-backed 4096-byte normalized-ROM HASH.SAV; uPD96050 reset preserves data RAM and two-start Session test restores it before execution
st01x_reference_cases.private_gate: Optional only: exact known ST010 and ST011 digests and successful bounded firmware boot in place; no firmware byte, command table or commercial ROM is emitted
st01x_reference_cases.data_policy: Original in-memory synthetic firmware only in public tests; proprietary firmware, title-derived command HLE and downloads are forbidden

st018_reference_cases.persistence: Exact battery-backed 16384-byte normalized-ROM HASH.SAV; reset preserves work RAM and two-start Session test restores it before ARM execution
st018_reference_cases.private_gate: Optional only: exact known 0x28000-byte digest and successful bounded ARM firmware boot in place; no firmware byte, command table or commercial ROM is emitted
st018_reference_cases.data_policy: One original generated open ARMv3/ST018 fixture is public. Proprietary firmware, title-derived command HLE and downloads are forbidden

suites.runner: Production CPU and bus until the ROM's terminal success/failure state, with first failing generated case decoded from tests.txt
suites.expectation: Success; all generated register, flag, stack, and memory cases pass
suites.limitations: Does not establish exact bus cycles, interrupts, WAI/STP, MMIO, PPU, or DMA timing

suites.runner: Production 65C816 plus timed 5A22 cartridge/bus port with bounded instruction/cycle trace and terminal screen/state decoder
suites.expectation: Success with no failed generated case
suites.limitations: Functional coverage is cross-checked with targeted cycle and interrupt owner tests

suites.region_model: NTSC LoROM with S-SMP upload protocol
suites.runner: Production S-CPU/APU ports plus S-SMP until Success or Failed terminal state
suites.limitations: Does not replace timer, DSP, IPL-speed, dummy-read, or full-system timing tests

suites.runner: Streaming execution through the production SPC700 with opcode/case diagnostics and exact initial/final registers, changed RAM and explicit read/write/wait comparison
suites.limitations: The vectors establish CPU bus phases but not S-DSP synthesis; timers, ports, SLEEP/STOP and synchronization remain separate owner cases

suites.region_model: Primarily NTSC SNES revisions; per-ROM source metadata is authoritative

case_sets.component: PPU, DMA/HDMA and console-revision edge behavior

suites.runner: Per-ROM bounded production-machine script; bind an exact completion address, trace invariant, or licensed hardware image before enabling each case as a gate
suites.expectation: Per-ROM expectation manifest derived from source comments and real-hardware material
suites.limitations: Many artifacts are demonstrations or visual/revision probes and remain non-gating diagnostics until a machine-readable oracle exists

suites.component: HDMA, INIDISP and S-CPU DMA glitches
suites.runner: Artifact digest/rebuild check plus the matching current-suite runner where a behavioral oracle exists
suites.expectation: Historical package remains reproducible; matching cases do not regress
suites.automation: required for provenance, mixed for behavior
suites.limitations: Historical duplicate snapshot, not an independent hardware oracle

suites.region_model: NTSC-J SNSRGB01 with documented SA-1 boards
suites.runner: Production machine polls guest address 0x000000: 0 running, 1 passed, 0xFF failed; reboot additionally treats 0xFE as no response and captures tilemap diagnostics at 0x001000
suites.limitations: Documented electrically indeterminate register and open-bus fields are masked, never guessed

suites.region_model: NTSC-J SNSRGB01 with documented LoROM/SA-1 boards
suites.component: SA-1, open bus, PPU multiplier and BW-RAM persistence
suites.runner: Bounded production dual-CPU/PPU execution plus exact tilemap/WRAM/device or defined-register digest; every phase emits raw tilemap and PPM evidence
suites.expectation: Completion and agreement on documented deterministic fields; indeterminate fields are reported but not asserted
suites.limitations: Utilities explicitly do not self-judge; SA1BackupUtility is therefore gated by an exact cold/warm two-run persistence protocol

suites.component: Video geometry, color, overscan, interlace, sound and controller
suites.runner: Scripted controller input with frame geometry, stable pixel-region and PCM invariants
suites.expectation: All scripted 256/512 by 224/239/448/478 modes publish the requested native geometry and bounded audio
suites.limitations: Subjective display and listening observations are reserved for 0.73.23
